items.text: **Let's start the journey with Copilot Chat**

Copilot Chat is the AI chat tool that supports you in **answering your questions**, generating content and ideas, and finding useful information. Remember that it is the **AI chat tool approved by our company**, which uses the latest AI models and information available on the web to facilitate your work. At the same time, it
**protects your data** so that the information from your conversations with the chat is not exposed publicly.

body.text:
You can chat with Copilot using questions and instructions, called prompts, to get a helpful response, idea, or action, for example:
- *Write a professional email to follow up after a client meeting*
- *Summarize the key points from this document*
- *Create a short LinkedIn post about our latest AI initiative*
**A few steps to try Copilot Chat right away**

items.text: 1. **Access Copilot Chat** from one of the following apps:

- **Microsoft Teams app** (on the left-hand sidebar)
- **Microsoft Outlook app** (on the left-hand sidebar)
- **Microsoft 365 Copilot app** (from the Windows taskbar)
- **Microsoft Edge app** (at the top right of your Edge page)
- **Navigate in your browser to [M365Copilot.com](https://m365copilot.com)** and log in with your corporate account.

2. **Write a prompt** or choose one of the available “prompts” in the Copilot Chat prompt box. Use simple but clear language and provide context to get better results. For example, "Write a speech on the pros and cons of social media. The target audience is pre-teens, so make it casual and youthful."

3. **You can also upload files** to get responses based on the information from your work documents, presentations, and more. Select the 'Add content' button to upload a file and try, for example, this prompt: "Summarize this document in 5 points".

body.text: **Ready to get started? Jump in today and discover a smarter way of working with Copilot. 🚀**
